title: Fortinet says ransomware groups listing Korean organisations on dark-web sites rose this year, Newsis reports
date_note: Newsis reports Fortinet presented the findings on 24 Nov 2026; the page gives no earlier day.
summary: Newsis reports that Fortinet presented findings at the AI Cybersecurity Summit 2026 in Seoul that ransomware groups listed more Korean companies and organisations on dark-web sites this year than last year. According to the report as relayed, manufacturing was the most-targeted sector in both periods. Fortinet's Kapil Gupta said attackers can now scale operations much faster using AI.
plain: Fortinet says more Korean organisations appear on ransomware leak sites this year than last, with manufacturing most targeted, Newsis reports.
exec: Fortinet, per Newsis, says ransomware listings of Korean organisations rose this year, with manufacturing the top sector.
